Cards Total | 154 |- ! Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below, two unique premiums (listed under Card list), and random reprints. Those reprints are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card. A foil of a title that is not on this list (and is not one of the box/case toppers) is not a Decipher Reflections II pack foil.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2].
